usage.source_scope: RGB-D streams, per-frame camera poses, textured meshes, per-face object and part semantics, and the door / door_frame label vocabulary needed to isolate real posed door surfaces.
usage.project_application: Highest-priority next L10 source candidate for source-side visible door-surface admission: freeze fresh scenes and source/query views, render labelled door triangles into the source camera with a z-buffer, and check the rendered surface against synchronized source depth before any cross-view transfer.
usage.modifications: Use MultiScan only as the proposed source/evaluator substrate. Require source-side visibility authority from z-buffered labelled triangles plus synchronized depth; keep query RGB/depth and query door truth evaluator-only, and preserve the existing referent, affordance, waypoint, arrival, and handoff boundaries.
usage.expected_effect: Replace the consumed partial-envelope credential with an occlusion-aware visible door-surface credential, making the next real-scene portal-transfer test evaluable without admitting mesh triangles hidden behind foreground geometry.

evaluation.claim_boundary: Priority records source fit, not a completed download, admitted cohort, or experiment result. Even a successful source-side z-buffer check would establish only an input credential for a bounded L10 test; it would not prove a traversable aperture, outdoor named-entrance grounding, access, approach, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Official documentation for RGB, depth, per-frame camera parameters, textured meshes, and per-face semantic annotation files.
Official source repository and benchmark label maps reviewed for object- and part-semantic support.

history.change: Added as the highest-priority L10 source candidate for a fresh source-side visible door-surface and z-buffer admission test; no route authority or experimental result was created.
